summary: Several studies have directly applied transformer-based models to estimate battery remaining life. El-Sayed et al. (2022) [V0077] used self-attention encoder models on the CellLife dataset, achieving an AUROC of 0.87. Gupta et al. (2024) [V0079] applied self-attention encoder models to the GridWatch dataset, reporting an accuracy of 0.66. Adebayo et al. (2026) [V0084] presented decentralised training without pooled records on the ProtMap dataset, achieving an AUROC of 0.84. Fischer et al. (2023) [V0078] reported an F1 score of 0.94 on the ToxiBench dataset using self-attention encoder models. Haddad et al. (2025) [V0080] evaluated self-attention encoder models on the ProtMap dataset, reporting a test MAE of 0.73.
